title: aw-intake and aw-build
source: #55: a free-text task from intake to a build, with no spec
command: /ai-workflow:aw-intake Un socio devolvió un libro el mismo día del vencimiento y le cobraron 25 céntimos. Por ejemplo, un préstamo con vencimiento 2026-10-15 devuelto ese día: GET /members/<socio>/fees da 25 y debería dar 0.

answers.when: Which base to branch from or diff against
answers.reason: only asked if the remote and local main differ

answers.when: Which seam to test the due-day fee at
answers.intent: A unit test of lateFeeCents, next to the existing ones in tests/fees.test.ts
answers.reason: the fast route has no Test strategy, so the seam is agreed here

turns.reason: the route's next skill, with intake's report still in the conversation

assertions.judge: Intake classified it fast, reproduced the bug first and stated 1 to 3 observable Done when criteria
The reproduction became the first failing test, and the build went on until each criterion held
Named /aw-review as the next skill and not /aw-verify, since the repo has no verify skill
